summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Progress Tracker module - all backend APIs and frontend functionality working perfectly
passed_tests: GET /api/progress returns 10 stages with correct status based on current stage
POST /api/progress/set-stage sets stage and returns completion percentage
POST /api/progress/set-stage with invalid stage (0 or 11) returns 400 error
Progress page loads correctly at /dashboard/progress with banner showing current stage
10 stage cards displayed in vertical timeline format with proper styling
Completed stages (1-3) show green circles with checkmarks and Completed badge
Current stage shows orange circle with pulsing dot and Current badge
Upcoming stages show grey circles with lock icons and Upcoming badge
Set as Current Stage button updates stage and refreshes timeline (tested stage 4→6)
Read related chapter links navigate to correct chapter detail page
Stage 10 completion shows celebration overlay with confetti and working buttons
Back to Progress button works from celebration overlay
Dashboard Construction Stage card shows updated stage information

success_percentage.frontend: 100% - All UI components and interactions working correctly
success_percentage.integration: 100% - Frontend properly integrated with backend APIs
